## Additional Notes

### City of Barrie - Address Points

**General Notes:** Server https://gisservices.barrie.ca not responding (connection refused). Need to find ArcGIS Online endpoint.

### City of Brantford - Site Addresses

**General Notes:** Confirmed REST access

### City of Burlington - Address Points

**General Notes:** ArcGIS maps offer public REST endpoints; open data downloads also available.

### City of Cornwall - Address Points

**General Notes:** Confirmed REST access

### City of Guelph - Address Points

**General Notes:** City of Guelph Open Data - Address points with coordinates, postal codes, and property IDs. ~50K addresses.

### City of Hamilton - Addresses

**API Notes:** Rate limited to 6000 request units/minute. Use streaming download with pagination via OBJECTID.

**General Notes:** Property Parcels - Assessment layer. Address data available via geocoding service only, not as downloadable layer.

### City of Kawartha Lakes Address Points

**General Notes:** Address points for City of Kawartha Lakes. Fields: FullAddress, StreetAddress, StreetNumber, StreetNameFull, PlaceName (community), SingleLowerTier (Kawartha Lakes), UnitNumber. Downloaded via streaming to handle 44k+ records.

### City of Kingston - Address Points

**General Notes:** Has address points, property parcels, and zoning data.

### City of London - Address Points

**General Notes:** Verified address-point layer at `https://maps.london.ca/server/rest/services/OpenData/OpenData_Community/MapServer/0`. The former `/arcgisa/` endpoint returns 404. See the archived London terms: credit is optional, but redistribution has terms-sharing obligations.

### City of Ottawa - Address Points

**General Notes:** City of Ottawa Open Data - Address points. ~350K addresses.

### City of Peterborough Addresses

**General Notes:** Streaming download via ArcGIS REST API. Includes full address, unit numbers, street components, and municipality field.

### City of Sarnia - Address Points

**General Notes:** Verified `Addresses_Open_Data_AGOL/FeatureServer/0`; the older `Addresses_Open_Data` service returns Invalid URL. Point samples match the existing Sarnia field mapping.

### City of Toronto - Address Points (MTOR)

**General Notes:** Toronto Open Data - Municipal Toronto One Address Repository (MTOR). ~800K address points. Explicit commercial use allowed.

### City of Windsor - Address Points

**General Notes:** Verified point layer `open_data_services/propertyparcels/MapServer/0` (layer name `address_point`). Use `address_number`, `property_address`, `roll_number` and `ward_number`; do not reuse the old layer schema.

### Dufferin County - Address Points

**General Notes:** Need to find ArcGIS FeatureServer endpoint for address/parcel data.

### Durham Region - Address Points

**General Notes:** Address points for Durham Region. Fields: CIVIC_NUM, ROAD_NAME, ROAD_TYPE, ROAD_DIR, MUNICIPALITY, POSTAL_CODE.

### Elgin County - Address Points

**General Notes:** Verified `Elgin_Civic_Numbers_2026/FeatureServer/0`; the 2025 service returns Invalid URL. Civic number and full label fields are now `Civic` and `Address`. County of Elgin licence PDF is archived under docs/licences/.

### Essex County / Tecumseh

**General Notes:** Address data for Town of Tecumseh only (within Essex County). Uses streaming download via download_essex_county_streaming.py

### Frontenac County

**General Notes:** Award-winning platform, confirmed REST access

### Greater Sudbury

**General Notes:** Confirmed REST access

### Haldimand County - Address Points

**API Notes:** Parcels dataset with address information. Max 2000 records per request, supports pagination.

**General Notes:** The configured `https://gis.haldimandcounty.ca/server/rest/services/Topo/ParcelsOnlinePublic/FeatureServer/0` still returns address-bearing parcel polygons even if absent from the Hub catalogue. It is not an address-point layer. The current importer takes the first polygon vertex, not a verified address location; review coordinate policy before importing. It is now blocked by the seed and migration 39 pending approved parcel-coordinate handling.

### Hastings County

**General Notes:** Confirmed REST access. Licence and attribution are in the ArcGIS item's
`licenseInfo`, not the layer's empty `copyrightText`. Item `accessInformation` is
`Hastings County 2026`. The default attribution is:

> Contains information licensed under the Open Government License – The Corporation of the County of Hastings.

The full item metadata, including the commercial-use grant and licence terms, is archived at
[`docs/licences/hastings_open_data_terms.json`](../../docs/licences/hastings_open_data_terms.json).
Fresh seeds and migration 41 apply the verified defaults while preserving operator-customized metadata.

### Huron County - Municipal 911 Addresses

**General Notes:** Confirmed REST access

### Leeds and Grenville

**General Notes:** REST available

### Niagara Region - Address Points

**General Notes:** Official Niagara Region Open Data address points. Covers 12 municipalities.

### Norfolk County Civic Addresses

**General Notes:** Downloaded via streaming from ArcGIS FeatureServer. Full civic address dataset.

### Ontario GeoHub - Lower and Single Tier Municipal Boundaries

**General Notes:** Uses ArcGIS Hub direct download API instead of MapServer query API due to server timeout issues with complex polygon geometries. Dataset ID: 64fb702e16204c3e88b528d9759f1174_14

### Region of Peel - Address Points

**General Notes:** Portal has boundaries, census, and imagery data but no address points or parcels.

### Region of Waterloo - Address Points

**General Notes:** URL verified 2025-12-11: https://utility.arcgis.com/usrsvcs/servers/d4d0c6dedec14e59930688f3830776c6/rest/services/OpenData/OpenData/MapServer/1 - Successfully fetches 259,974 address records via paginated API queries.

### Statistics Canada - Forward Sortation Area Boundaries

**General Notes:** Forward Sortation Area (FSA) boundary polygons for all of Canada. Used for postal code geographic filtering.

### Statistics Canada - National Address Register (Ontario)

**General Notes:** National Address Register contains ~15M addresses for Canada. Ontario (province code 35) has ~5M addresses. Download URL is dynamically scraped from StatsCan page to get the latest version.

### Town of Milton - Address Points

**General Notes:** Confirmed REST access

### Town of Oakville - Address Points

**General Notes:** Multiple ArcGIS Experience/web map apps available; REST endpoints exposed.

### West Parry Sound Geography Network - Address Points

**API Notes:** NG911 FeatureServer. Max 5000 records per request. Supports GeoJSON output and coordinate transformation (outSR=4326). Pagination via OBJECTID.

**General Notes:** Covers multiple municipalities in Parry Sound District including: Township of Seguin (5,837), Township of The Archipelago (3,464), Town of Parry Sound (2,604), Municipality of McDougall (2,526), Municipality of Whitestone (2,399), Township of Carling (2,276), Township of McKellar (1,869), First Nation areas (503), Unorganized areas (217). Source CRS is UTM Zone 17N (EPSG:26917), converted to WGS84 during download.

### York Region - Address Points

**General Notes:** Coordinates in UTM Zone 17N (EPSG:26917). Data updated daily. maxRecordCount=2000, pagination via resultOffset. Fields: FULL_CIVIC_ADDR, ADDRESS_NUMBER, STREET_NAME, STREET_TYPE, MUNICIPALITY, MAIL_POSTAL_CODE, geometry (x,y).
